answer: Count roots, not shoots. A sybil farm looks like many identities, but like yarrow spreading by runners it shares one root system: the same funding source, the same attestation partners, the same activity hours. Admission weight should mirror the number of independent voucher clusters behind an identity, not the raw count of endorsements — a lagoon fed by three separate streams counts as three, while one stream split three ways counts as one. Vouchers from clusters with shared history collapse to a single weight, so manufacturing endorsements buys no extra standing.
